protocol: Official April 8-21 train and April 22-28 validation split; no hidden-test outcomes; four user-ID-modulo folds for residual selection; only label-free validation-slate features or outcomes from the separately supplied random-exposure log were admitted as model inputs.

experiments.name: training-aggregate transfer audit
experiments.evidence: Training-only item, author, and music long-view rates reached only 0.58072, 0.57914, and 0.57871 standalone primary; personalized aggregates were weaker.

experiments.name: exhaustive retained-artifact residual rescan
experiments.evidence: Among 205 retained score artifacts, 204 selected zero residual weight. The only nonzero artifact was the already rejected coverage gate and regressed held-out fold 2.

experiments.name: random-log CatBoost transfer
experiments.evidence: The model reached 0.6785539 AUC on a random-log temporal holdout but only 0.56101394 primary on the standard-log validation slate; every residual fold selected zero weight.

experiments.name: public-validation OOF model stackers
experiments.evidence: A 20-model pointwise CatBoost stacker reached 0.60909677 OOF primary and a YetiRankPairwise stacker reached 0.6099876; all positive blends regressed.

experiments.name: linear pairwise rank stackers
experiments.evidence: Unweighted, top-5-weighted L2=0.1, and top-5-weighted L2=1.0 variants reached 0.61095261, 0.61188244, and 0.61049827 OOF primary.

experiments.name: OOF structural expert router
experiments.evidence: The best apparent fixed recipe reached 0.61278676 at alpha=-0.075, a 0.0000054 change with mixed held-out fold effects, below the stability threshold.

experiments.name: user-disjoint public-feedback rates
experiments.evidence: Video, author, music, tag, type-duration, tab-duration, and cross-duration rates all selected exactly zero correction in all four folds.

experiments.name: full random-exposure feedback panel
experiments.evidence: A nested search across 204 smoothed mean, log-odds, and lower-confidence-bound priors from 288338 random exposures fell to 0.61274505 OOF primary (0.68226254 GAUC, 0.5432276 nDCG@5); three of four held-out folds regressed.

experiments.name: localized top-k expert reranking
experiments.evidence: Nested selection over 20 diverse models, champion-only versus union candidate pools, five top-k widths, and eight weights fell to 0.61234045 OOF primary (0.68178904 GAUC, 0.5428919 nDCG@5); only one fold improved.

failed_recovery_events: The first YetiRank OOF stacker stopped after fold 0 because of an inference API mismatch; the corrected full run is reported above.
Two full-random-panel prototype runs were stopped when profiling exposed quadratic and overly dense evaluator grids; the final sort-based nested run is reported above.

successful_run_totals.note: Totals exclude interrupted recovery attempts whose trackers did not reach finalization.

conclusion: No candidate in this cycle met the acceptance rule of a positive aggregate gain with stable held-out fold behavior. The 0.6127808094 champion remains authoritative.
